description: Scorecard of experimentally validated COQ8A nucleotide-site residues across the UbiB family
code:
exec(open("lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, json, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
seqs=load_seqs()
ORDER=["COQ8A_HUMAN","COQ8B_HUMAN","COQ8_YEAST","ADCK5_HUMAN","ADCK1_HUMAN","CQD2_MCP2_YLR253W",
       "UBIB_ECOLI","CQD1_YPL109C","ADCK2_HUMAN"]
ref=seqs["COQ8A_HUMAN"]; maps={n:map_ref(ref,seqs[n]) for n in ORDER}
# COQ8A positions with published mutagenesis phenotypes (UniProt Q8NI60, from PMID 25498144 / 27499294 / 29198567)
SITES=[("K276","KxGQ Lys",276,"Impaired COQ complex; selectivity unchanged"),
       ("Q279","KxGQ Gln",279,"Selectivity unchanged"),
       ("A339","A-rich loop Ala",339,"A339G enables autophosphorylation, blocks CoQ synthesis"),
       ("S340","A-rich loop Ser",340,"ATP contact"),
       ("K358","beta3 Lys",358,"K358R abolishes ADP/ATP binding"),
       ("E411","alphaC Glu",411,"E411Q impairs ADP/ATP binding"),
       ("E446","hinge Glu",446,"ATP contact"),
       ("D488","catalytic-loop Asp",488,"D488N impairs ADP/ATP binding"),
       ("N493","Mg-binding Asn",493,"N493A impairs ADP/ATP binding"),
       ("D507","DFG-like Asp",507,"D507N strongly impairs ADP/ATP binding"),
       ("F508","DFG Phe (R-spine)",508,"not mutated"),
       ("G509","DFG Gly",509,"not mutated")]
rows=[]
for n in ORDER:
    r={"protein":n}
    for lbl,desc,p,note in SITES:
        r[lbl]=maps[n].get(p,'-')
    rows.append(r)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("protein")
df.to_csv("ubib_site_scorecard.csv")
print(df.to_string())
ident=(df.values==np.array([ref[p-1] for _,_,p,_ in SITES])[None,:])
df_sc=pd.DataFrame({"identical_to_COQ8A":ident.sum(1),"of":len(SITES)},index=df.index)
print("\n",df_sc.to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.4))
ax.imshow(ident.astype(int),cmap=plt.cm.colors.ListedColormap(["#F2F2F2","#4C78A8"]),aspect='auto',vmin=0,vmax=1)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(SITES))); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{s[0]}\n{s[1]}" for s in SITES],fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(ORDER))); ax.set_yticklabels(ORDER,fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(ORDER)):
    for j in range(len(SITES)):
        ax.text(j,i,df.values[i,j],ha='center',va='center',fontsize=9,
                color='white' if ident[i,j] else '#333333')
ax.set_title("Nucleotide-site residues of COQ8A mapped across the UbiB family\n(blue = identical to human COQ8A; alignment anchored on COQ8A)",fontsize=10)
yl=ORDER.index("ADCK1_HUMAN")
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((-0.5,yl-0.5),len(SITES),1,fill=False,ec='#E45756',lw=2.5))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
